definitions.name: CARA surplus
definitions.rewards: Risk-adjusted surplus after payments; constant dollar absolute aversion.
definitions.ignores: No special increase in aversion near payment floor. No direct path/consumption preference.

definitions.name: CRRA gross
definitions.rewards: Relative-risk preference on total marked terminal wealth.
definitions.ignores: Payment reserve absent from objective, but present in shared constraints. Domain G>0.

definitions.name: HARA payment floor
definitions.rewards: Surplus above the terminal payment reserve, cautious near floor.
definitions.ignores: Undefined at/below floor; training feasibility is not all-support admissibility. Same as CRRA on net surplus at matched gamma.

definitions.name: Kinked shortfall
definitions.rewards: Ending surplus; marginal downside penalty5times upside below target.
definitions.ignores: Risk-neutral above target. Not an all-payment probability objective or S-shaped prospect theory.

scope: FROZEN RETROSPECTIVE RESEARCH. User confirmed $250k/month; 12 modeled monthly calls total $3M. Due weeks are approximate, not calendar settlement dates. Other amounts are labelled sensitivities or check stress tests, NOT user obligations. Fixed research inputs: $100M wealth, 10% unsold property, zero rent/cash, 100 train / 200 validation / 400 final paths x4. Not recomputed when controls change. Same paths, EP and all-risk+strict judge. Default remains CARA; native gross/net CEs are not cross-family rankings.
takeaway: No utility winner established for the confirmed $250k/month schedule: all four choose a 25% candidate / 75% anchor blend and pass this final fitted-model judge. Hard constraints mostly dominate. Sensitivities are not obligations. Extreme check stress tests establish limits, not realistic payment scenarios. Raw HARA has domain failures there; the family name cannot cure infeasibility.
